open_points.subject: repeated delivery after a failed placement-record write
open_points.text: When no refusal of A6 rule 5 applies, a delivery repeated after a failed record write completes the placement (`test_a_delivery_repeated_after_a_failed_record_write_completes`).
open_points.question: Which module must check for every A6 rule 5 refusal during this retry, including a damaged mark without a placement, and in what order must those checks occur before `photo_delivery` rewrites the image and placement record?
options: `photo_delivery` must request both placement and mark reads before writing, while `delivery_store` detects and returns any A6 rule 5 refusal
`delivery_store` must perform all required record checks atomically behind a new retry capability
Only records explicitly needed by the normal placement path are checked, so an unread mark is not examined during the retry
open_points.default_guess: Have `photo_delivery` read both placement and mark under the project lock before any retry write, with `delivery_store` owning validation and returning `state_unavailable`.

witness.initial: A prior delivery wrote the stored image but failed to write its placement record; the project also has a damaged mark record without a placement, a state explicitly covered by INV-20.
events: The caller repeats delivery of the same source content.
One implementation asks `delivery_store` to read both placement and mark before writing; another checks only for an existing placement and then follows the failed-record retry path.
outcomes: The operation returns M08 with `state_unavailable` and changes no stored image or record.
The operation rewrites the image and completes the placement despite the damaged mark.
witness.observer: The caller sees refusal versus successful placement, and an operator sees different durable state.
